name: EPIC 248557858
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 9.4 solar radii and 0.98 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248557858 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.381115 (16th-84th percentiles 8.967723-9.816207), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,812 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.98 solar masses and 9.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,784 K at its surface.
